title: Job Fair 2
summary: A Job Fair was conducted on 26 September 2026 at YMCA, DN Nagar, Andheri-West, with Rotary Club of Bombay Airport as the host, in association with Vedanta Foundation and three other Partner Rotary Clubs.
description: A Job Fair was conducted on 26 September 2026 at YMCA, DN Nagar, Andheri-West, with Rotary Club of Bombay Airport as the host, in association with Vedanta Foundation and three other Partner Rotary Clubs. The fair received 450 registrations, with 20 companies participating in the interview process. The initiative was attended by PP Rajesh, Rtn Swati Agarwal, PP Sitaramji, Rtn Derrick, Rtn Pravin Shah and Partner Shobhana Shah from RCBA. The initiative was spearheaded by PP Rajesh Agarwal.
location: YMCA, DN Nagar, Andheri-West, Mumbai, Maharashtra
